description: React component for prefetching channel data in Mattermost, managing prefetch queue, handling updates, and optimizing data fetches based on user activity and channel state.

classes.name: DataPrefetch
classes.description: React.PureComponent subclass responsible for prefetching channel data based on various triggers and conditions.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Handles component updates, triggers profile loading, prefetching, and queue management based on prop changes.

methods.name: prefetchPosts
methods.description: Prefetches posts for a specific channel, adding a delay if the last post was recent.

methods.name: prefetchData
methods.description: Iterates over prefetch queue object to schedule prefetching for channels not yet requested.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Returns null, as this component does not render UI.
